experiments.name: Rewrite exploration — verification track (subagent)
experiments.blurb: Behavior-preservation harness with sandboxed throwaway R runs: runnable fraction 19/50 (38%) of arbitrary corpus functions; gate calibration both ways (0 false positives on benign renames, 14/15 injected single defects caught); execution verification widens loop-rewrite supply 7x (0.62% vs 0.06% strict static). REAL verified rewrites: 53.6x / -5 LOC and 3.7x / -7 LOC, digest-equal at all sizes; reverse cases confirmed (some modernizations gain nothing — no_op wins). TWO CATCHES: a naive vectorization that is WRONG (digest gate caught length-sensitive identical()), and a 50x block speedup that is only 1.09x function-wide (function-scoped perf claims enforced). Gate costs 0.2ms to 105s — static-first ordering ~1000x cheaper.
experiments.verdict: Committed 72b283f. The gates demonstrably catch both wrong rewrites and misleading claims — verified-better is buildable; judge never needed for the objective core.

Smells: 28.2% of fns flagged — gates/difficulty knobs, dead-assign deletion is the one exact LOC-reducing smell family. Fix-issue injection arm 30/30 gates.
experiments.verdict: Committed 62ac07a. Volume strategy: inject dirt backward for (dirty, clean) pairs; elegance mine re-rated to eval-only; awaits the verification-track sibling for synthesis.

experiments.name: GLM-5.3 post-training read-out

decisions: Suffix-completion convention everywhere: predict ONLY what comes after the cursor (user decision; finish-block re-emission retired).
Dropout conditioning is the production config — justified by robustness to prompt population, not type signal (ablation showed none).
Telemetry: local collection always, upload never — until an explicit opt-in (off by default).
Eval battery: acceptance counters (extension) > validator-exact scenario families + calibrated judge + intent assertions > line-F1 midtyping (composition-blind, 4 datapoints).
Effort is never a blocker; llama.cpp support is deployment evidence, not selection criteria. Wide architecture space gets a genuine pass.
Quota discipline: max 6-8 concurrent zai consumers; Gemini (agy) and Opus 4.6 (separate quota) for free-tier generation; Opus reserved for high-judgment tasks.
Ops: llama-server evals CPU-only; readiness via POST /v1/completions (never /health); kill by tracked PID/port only; GPU jobs strictly sequential (flock, not memory polls — the 03:20 incident).
